title: The site centres on flows: home shows the Supervisor running every flow as a map, nav is Flows, Needs you and Under the hood, and each flow has its own page
description: The Owner wants FlowWeb built around flows working for him: one primary agent, the Supervisor, running several flows of other agents, drawn with the design system's flow visuals. Today the home page shows flows as a small card and each flow's detail lives on a long Growth page, so the product reads as a dashboard of settings. Replace the home page (/) with packages/web/src/flows/FlowsHome.tsx: a greeting and headline with four figures (running now, drafts to check, decisions waiting, spent today); the Needs you strip (saffron only when something waits) with links for drafts ready to send and decisions waiting; a Supervisor map with the Supervisor at the centre, its run slots (max_concurrent) and how many are running, and every flow from GET /v1/supervisor around it as a link to /flows/<key> showing its ring, state word and dial, a line that lights and moves only while that flow runs, and an Add a flow spot; an Every flow list with one FlowLine per flow through Find, Draft, You check, Sent, Replies, positioned only from what fwd reported (running, ready drafts, open asks, sent and replied counts), with each held flow's reason; and the open region's progress. The nav becomes Flows (/), Needs you (/inbox) and Under the hood (/hood); the phone bar is Flows, Needs you, More. /flows/<key> opens that flow's page (the current Growth page) and /growth keeps working, both under the Flows tab. Anything fwd did not answer reads Unknown, never zero; motion only while a flow runs, none in calm or reduced motion. This supersedes the nav checks of FW-C-067 and the home checks of FW-C-069: park both rows when this lands. No em dashes.
acceptance: The top nav is Flows, Needs you and Under the hood linking to /, /inbox and /hood; the phone bar is /, /inbox and /more
routeOf maps /flows/<key> and /growth to the flow page and /flows to home; tabOf puts every flow page under the Flows tab
The home page shows a Supervisor group with how many of its slots are running and its state, and every supervisor flow around it as a link to /flows/<key>, plus Add a flow
The home page lists every flow through Find, Draft, You check, Sent and Replies, each linking to its page, with a held flow's reason
The Needs you strip links drafts ready to send and decisions waiting to /inbox; the open region's progress stays on the page
With fwd unreachable the page says so and values read Unknown, not zero
